name: KromiumHardwareConfig
declaration: @ConsistentCopyVisibility data class KromiumHardwareConfig internal constructor(val processModel: KromiumProcessModel, val gpuMode: KromiumGpuMode)
description: Controls how the engine interacts with the host OS and GPU. Configures Chromium process isolation architecture and graphics rendering acceleration mode.
whenToUse: Configure within KromiumConfig.builder().hardwareConfig { ... } to enable full GPU acceleration, disable GPU compositing, or activate software fallbacks in virtual machines.

properties.name: processModel
properties.description: The process isolation architecture: AUTO (multi-process helper), OUT_OF_PROCESS (external RPC daemon), or IN_PROCESS (embedded).

properties.name: gpuMode
properties.description: Graphics rendering strategy: HARDWARE (full GPU), SOFTWARE (SwiftShader), COMPOSITING_DISABLED (CPU compositing), or ANGLE_WARP (Direct3D 11 WARP).

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for KromiumHardwareConfig.

frameworkExamples.code:
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumHardwareConfig
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumProcessModel
import org.daviante.kromium.api.config.KromiumGpuMode

val hardwareConfig = KromiumHardwareConfig.builder()
    .processModel(KromiumProcessModel.AUTO)
    .gpuMode(KromiumGpuMode.HARDWARE)
    .build()
